_comment: notiwatchd rules. First match wins. match fields: bundle_id (exact, string or array), title/subtitle/body (case-insensitive regex, string or array). Absent field = wildcard. actions: log | ignore | dismiss (AX close of on-screen banner; needs Accessibility grant) | ntfy | ntfy:phone | exec:<cmd> | webhook:<url>. urgency: normal | high | critical (passed to ntfy -u).

rules.name: message-reactions
rules._comment: Tapbacks quote the original message, so a reaction to a question would otherwise match urgent-messages.

rules.name: group-messages
rules._comment: Group chats carry a subtitle (chat name or recipients); 1:1 chats have none. Keeps group questions out of urgent-messages.

rules.name: urgent-messages
rules._comment: Sentence-ending '?': not followed by URL/word characters, so '?q=1' links don't match.
